platform.name: Deedseal
platform.statement: Deedseal is the canonical platform name. Every canonical topology artifact of this packet identifies the platform as Deedseal and never as KBP.
platform.namespace_note: These are internal engineering or legacy identifiers: repository names, schema ids, package prefixes and historical address roots. They are not renamed by this packet and they are not the platform name. This manifest performs no global rename.

adoption.statement: This manifest freezes topology, not runtime activation. Issue #644: 'This decision establishes topology, not runtime activation.'

not_implemented_at_this_stage: SQL contour registry activation: core.contour_registry seeds exactly one contour under contour_registry_one_seed with registration_gate OWNER_DECISION_REQUIRED; the repository canon may name three contours while the database seeds one, because that constraint governs activation and this record governs topology. No migration is written or run by this packet
Owner Personal and Construction Department rosters: #644 froze the contours, not their internals, and no Owner decision names them yet
Session Passport v1 / executable Session Cursor extension: deferred by OWNER_DECISION D-4 to a separate packet; no passport, cursor or worker schema is touched here
the frozen Engineering primary role identifier: #644 defers it to the engineering-role canon packet, so this manifest references a role id and does not freeze one
runtime enforcement: nothing at runtime reads this manifest to admit or deny an action; it is a checked record, and the work-class policy remains the enforcement surface
no service, scheduler, queue, daemon, credential, protected-host contact or external publication is introduced by this record or its checker

contours.title: Engineering / Product Creation
contours.scope: Deedseal Core and DEV OFFICE engineering; research, architecture, implementation, independent review, release preparation and evidence; Product 1 / Deedseal as an internal product scope and deployment target; the Design Studio capability pack; replaceable model workers selected by role and model policy.
contours.note: Product 1 keeps its repository, runtime, deployment credentials and release evidence isolated by execution profile and receives no top-level contour. It is not a Department: OWNER_DECISION 5365485287 corrected the briefing on exactly this point, and this packet mints no project or workspace taxonomy.

contours.title: Owner Personal
contours.smallest_missing_fact: the repository and entry file of the Owner Personal door. #644 declares the contour and its trust boundary; it names no repository, and this packet does not invent one. Until an Owner decision names it, the door is declared-not-opened rather than pointed at a file that does not exist.
contours.scope: private Owner memory, personal tasks, decisions, documents, approvals and personal ContextPackets, with data and credentials isolated from Engineering and Construction.
contours.note: It may approve bounded proposals and inherits no arbitrary engineering or construction execution authority. Declaring a contour is not activating it: no roster, no credential, no store and no route is created here.

contours.title: Construction
contours.scope: the ADU and construction operational domain: property, GIS and project records, clients, permits, contractors, commercial operations and physical-world effects.
contours.note: Isolated because its data, credentials, legal and commercial consequences and blast radius differ materially from Engineering and Owner Personal. Business-process activation stays deferred until the Owner opens it explicitly.

department_grammar.cardinality: a Department belongs to exactly one contour and is never shared between two
department_grammar.authority: a Department is an organizational record. It grants nothing: authority continues to come only from role plus capability plus a Gate decision.
department_grammar.alias_note: Screened by measured occurrence at 2859b53: Department occurs zero times in the tree, and every alias above is either already taken by a committed vocabulary or collides in prose. MODULE_SUBGRAPH in particular is one of the four adopted graph node types and a hard SQL constraint; a Department is not a graph node and introduces no fifth node type.

departments.title: Research
departments.mandate: read the world and the repository, and produce briefings and measured findings

departments.title: Architecture
departments.mandate: decide structure, contracts and boundaries, and record them as canon

departments.title: Software Factory
departments.mandate: implement bounded packets in a worktree and prove them locally

departments.title: Review / Verification
departments.mandate: adversarial exact-head review and independent verification, never of its own work

departments.title: Infrastructure
departments.mandate: the substrate the other Departments run on, up to but never past the Gate/Broker line

departments.title: Release / Evidence
departments.mandate: prepare releases and preserve append-only evidence, receipts and read models

packs.title: Design Studio
packs.note: A named, bounded subset of existing cap.* ids attachable to a Department's work. It defines no capability of its own and holds no authority. Design Studio creation stays inside Engineering; any public publishing is an external effect that must pass the common Gate/Broker path with exact authority, and content generation grants no publication authority. A future independent Design Studio contour requires a new Owner decision with its own trust, data and authority boundary.

capability_reference.statement: Every capability a Department or pack names is a reference into the pinned profile; neither defines one. Publication authority is denied structurally rather than by assertion: the merged work-class policy gives these operation kinds capability 'none', so no capability and therefore no pack can grant them, and they fire RED_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION, RED_EXTERNAL_EFFECT, RED_LIVE_SYSTEM, RED_CREDENTIAL_ACCESS and RED_MAIN_OR_MERGE_AUTHORITY. This manifest cites that policy; it does not restate or weaken it.

shared_substrate.statement: All three contours reuse one governed platform substrate. Shared substrate is not a fourth contour and is refused by name if it is counted as one. It implies no shared raw memory, credential or authority: cross-contour exchange uses typed references, events and bounded ContextPackets, and direct cross-contour data or tool access fails closed.
components: append-only evidence, receipts and read models

the frozen public cross-reference wording; the seam that carries it is remapped, its bytes are not

legacy_session_tokens.statement: Session Passport v0 keeps its own closed contour vocabulary and is not retokenized by this packet. Existing v0 preambles stay valid: nothing here edits the passport record, its validator or its two acceptance guards. The mapping is declared so a reader of an old preamble can resolve it, not so a session is forced to break.

session_contract.deferred_extension: Session Passport v1 / executable Session Cursor, OWNER_DECISION D-4 — a separate packet
session_contract.statement: There is exactly one session/worker binding record and this manifest is not it. A contour, Department or pack record that declared any field above would be a second, competing session contract, and it is refused by name rather than merged.
